listing.name: Duke Nukem: Zero Hour Recompiled
listing.summary: Native Duke Nukem: Zero Hour recompilation.

steps.title: Run the Linux ARM64 package
steps.instruction: Extract the release ZIP, then unpack DNZHRecompiled.tar.gz. Start DNZHRecompiled from the extracted folder. The current ARM64 build needs glibc 2.34 or newer, SDL2, GTK 3, libatomic and a Vulkan-capable driver.

steps.title: Install the Linux x64 Flatpak
steps.instruction: Extract the Flatpak x64 ZIP to get io.github.dnzhrecomp.dnzhrecomp.flatpak. Install the file with Flatpak, then start io.github.dnzhrecomp.dnzhrecomp from the app menu or with flatpak run io.github.dnzhrecomp.dnzhrecomp.

steps.title: Open the Mac app
steps.instruction: Choose the official Intel and Apple Silicon ZIP. Extract the outer release ZIP, then use Archive Utility to extract DNZHRecompiled.zip to get DNZHRecompiled.app. Open the app from its permanent folder.

steps.title: Select your original
steps.instruction: In the upstream game picker choose your own USA Duke Nukem: Zero Hour cartridge dump. The game validates the matching original before play.

warnings: These packages use upstream or player-managed setup, replacement and data backups. Portcove has no native execution or populated-save result for these sibling packages.

references.title: Keep the external profile
references.instruction: Preserve ~/.config/DNZHRecompiled on Linux and the DNZHRecompiled profile under ~/Library/Application Support on Mac, or your actual custom profile. For Flatpak also keep ~/.var/app/io.github.dnzhrecomp.dnzhrecomp. Back up the original, saves, mods and settings before replacing an upstream copy.
